text:
Noah Rivera: Quick idea 
After-work pop-up this Thurs: ping-pong micro-tourney + tapas from the new place on 5th. 6:30
Whos in? :table_tennis:
Sofia Martinez: Ooo yes! can we do 7pm? i have a standup that runs late. :clock7:
Noah Rivera: @Sofia 7pm ok. want me to add to calendar?
Kai Huang: count me in. can someone bring extra paddles? i only have one.
Rita Patel: i can bring 2 paddles + some spare balls. also vegetarian tapas okay?
Zoe Kim: vendor has vegan options. i can handle ordering. estimated cost $10/person. ok to charge to social card? :money_with_wings:
Noah Rivera: social card fine. can people RSVP here pls. quick yay/nay
Kai Huang: yay
Sofia Martinez: yay (food: vegetarian)
Rita Patel: yay (gf)
Zoe Kim: yay (vegan)
Noah Rivera: perfect. created tiny sign-up just for headcount: https://tinyurl.com/rw-pingpong-pop
Noah Rivera: quick checklist for volunteers:
```
- bring 2 folding tables (for courts)
- paddles/balls
- napkins + plates
- cash for vendor tip
- phone to play music
```
Sofia Martinez: i can grab tables from storage at 6:15 and bring bluetooth speaker.
Rita Patel: ill pick up tapas at 6:45 if Zoe sends the order.
Zoe Kim: sending order now, ETA 6:40. will send payment request in Slack.
SetupBot: Event created: "Ping-Pong & Tapas Pop-up" Thu 7:00PM  Lunch-plans channel invited.
Noah Rivera: should we make a tiny bracket or just chill games? vote: 1) bracket tournament 2) casual rotate 3) doubles only
Kai Huang: 1 :)
Sofia Martinez: 2 (prefer casual)
Rita Patel: 3
Noah Rivera: leaning casual to keep it easy. final call: casual rotate unless 8+ ppl want bracket.
Zoe Kim: final note  bring reusable plate if you can (vendor gives discount).
Noah Rivera: thanks everyone! will post final reminder at 3pm Thu. :party_popper:
Sofia Martinez: excited :sparkles:
